conditions: The minimum pickup is $125 — for just a few small items. Anything more is priced by the load.
Prices are for loading and hauling by volume — how much space your items take up in the truck.
Heavy material (concrete, brick, dirt, roofing shingles) adds about $75 per quarter load. Location, or needing equipment, can add more.
Anything with Freon — refrigerators, freezers, AC units, dehumidifiers — is $25 per item.
We can't take tires, batteries, liquid paint or hazardous materials.
Difficult access (long carries, several flights of stairs, tight crawlspaces) can add labor.
Demolition labor is quoted separately from hauling.
We confirm the final price before we load — in person, or by phone if you're not home. If it's more than you expected, you can say no.
examplesNote: Examples are typical, not promises — how things stack changes what fits.
